payload.name: Extract nicknames from direct address
payload.description: During extraction, when a speaker directly addresses someone using a nickname or shortened name, create a relationship memory capturing that nickname.
content: During extraction, identify nicknames or shortened names used in direct address (e.g., 'Hey Jo', 'Thanks Mike'). Create a relationship memory recording that the speaker uses that nickname for the named person, even when the same message also contains an event or other state.
Do not merge the nickname only into an event candidate; make it a separate relationship memory so it survives later SKIP/MERGE decisions.
Extract only nicknames explicitly stated in direct address; do not infer or generalize beyond the exact term used.

solves: The Construction Agent sometimes captures only the main event from a message and omits nicknames used in direct address (e.g., 'Hey Jo', 'Thanks Mike'). This causes later questions about what one person calls another to fail, because the nickname was never stored as a durable relationship memory.
